opening.argument: The exchange presents the hallmarks of a scambaiting test, not an established transaction: a purported support speaker proposes connecting to the device, discusses a repair fee and asks for card details, while the other participant directly challenges him as a scammer. The description frames the video as “Start Scambaiting,” and the confrontation reinforces that this is an investigation of the purported support conduct. The later exchange and Windows Vista dialog are consistent with a staged or testing-oriented demonstration. Although remote-access credentials, payment and card details are discussed, the evidence does not establish that access occurred, payment was made, or any account was affected.
